summary: Yosemite National Park is a breathtaking wilderness sanctuary featuring towering granite cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and ancient giant sequoias in California's Sierra Nevada mountains. Home to world-class hiking, rock climbing, and some of the most iconic photography locations on Earth, Yosemite offers unforgettable outdoor adventures for all skill levels. The park's stunning natural beauty and diverse ecosystems make it one of America's most treasured destinations.

restaurants.name: The Majestic Yosemite Hotel Dining Room
restaurants.description: Upscale restaurant within the historic Majestic Yosemite Hotel offering contemporary California cuisine with Yosemite Valley views. Features seasonal menus highlighting local ingredients and an extensive wine list.
restaurants.mustTry: Pan-seared trout with Sierra Nevada herbs

restaurants.name: Mountain Room Restaurant
restaurants.description: Casual fine dining at Yosemite Valley Lodge with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking waterfalls and cliffs. Known for steaks, salmon, and creative vegetarian options.

restaurants.name: Yosemite Valley Lodge Cafeteria
restaurants.description: Quick-service dining with diverse options including sandwiches, salads, pizza, and grab-and-go items perfect for hikers. Limited seating with convenient location.

restaurants.name: Tuolumne Meadows Grill and Burger Bar
restaurants.description: Rustic outdoor grill in Tuolumne Meadows serving burgers, hot dogs, and sandwiches in a scenic alpine setting. Open seasonally during summer months.

restaurants.name: Wawona Hotel Dining Room
restaurants.description: Historic Victorian-era restaurant in the charming Wawona Hotel featuring farm-to-table cuisine and classic American dishes. Elegant ambiance with fireplace dining.

restaurants.name: Curry Village Pizzeria
restaurants.description: Casual pizzeria in Curry Village offering freshly made pizzas, salads, and beer in a relaxed outdoor setting. Perfect for post-hike meals.

restaurants.name: Degnan's Kitchen
restaurants.description: Family-friendly restaurant near Yosemite Valley Lodge offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner with hearty portions and comfort food favorites.

restaurants.name: Ahwahnee Hotel Dining Room
restaurants.description: Historic grand dining room in the iconic Ahwahnee Hotel featuring fine French-inspired cuisine, floor-to-ceiling windows, and impeccable service. Dress code enforced.

restaurants.name: Badger Pass Ski Lodge Restaurant
restaurants.description: Mountain lodge dining serving hearty soups, stews, and warming dishes perfect for winter visitors and skiers. Cozy fireplace atmosphere.

restaurants.name: White Wolf Lodge Restaurant
restaurants.description: Casual lodge restaurant offering rustic comfort food, steaks, and vegetarian options in a historic high-country setting. Intimate dining experience.
restaurants.mustTry: Grilled chicken with mountain herb butter

restaurants.name: Glacier Point Snack Stand
restaurants.description: Seasonal outdoor snack stand at Glacier Point offering hot dogs, sandwiches, and beverages with panoramic valley views. Limited service hours.
restaurants.mustTry: Hot dogs and local craft beverages

restaurants.name: El Portal Village Cafe
restaurants.description: Charming village cafe just outside Yosemite Gate featuring homemade soups, sandwiches, and baked goods with local art on display. Community gathering spot.

activities.name: Mist Trail Hike
activities.description: Epic trail featuring Vernal Fall and Nevada Fall with misty spray and granite steps. Hikers get soaked in spray during spring runoff, creating an unforgettable experience.

activities.name: Half Dome Backpacking
activities.description: Multi-day wilderness trek to Half Dome summit with breathtaking views of Yosemite Valley and High Sierra lakes. Requires lottery permit and mountain experience.

activities.name: Glacier Point Scenic Drive
activities.description: Scenic 20-mile drive to 7,214-foot viewpoint offering panoramic views of Half Dome, Yosemite Valley, and Sierra peaks. Open summer through early fall.

activities.name: Valley Loop Trail Walk
activities.description: Easy 7.2-mile paved and dirt loop through Yosemite Valley with views of El Capitan, Bridalveil Fall, and meadows. Accessible for all fitness levels.

activities.name: Rock Climbing at El Capitan
activities.description: World-class climbing destination with routes from beginner to expert across massive granite monolith. Professional guides and gear rental available.

activities.name: Tuolumne Meadows Backpacking Loop
activities.description: High-country wilderness loops through pristine alpine meadows, past mountain lakes, and granite peaks. Multiple route options from 2 to 7 days.

activities.name: Mirror Lake Hike
activities.description: Scenic 5-mile round-trip hike to reflective alpine lake with mirror-like views of Half Dome and surrounding peaks. Easy to moderate difficulty.

activities.name: Yosemite Museum and History Center Tour
activities.description: Free museum exploring Native Miwok history, park history, and natural exhibits with native plant gardens. Guided ranger programs available.

activities.name: Stargazing and Night Sky Program
activities.description: Experience pristine dark skies with ranger-led night sky programs identifying constellations, planets, and galaxies. Telescope viewing available seasonally.

activities.name: Horseback Riding Tours
activities.description: Guided horseback tours ranging from scenic valley rides to multi-day high sierra pack trips. Available through licensed outfitters.

activities.name: Waterfall Circuit Photography Tour
activities.description: Self-guided or ranger-led tour visiting major waterfalls including Bridalveil, Yosemite, and Nevada Falls. Best in spring and early summer.

activities.name: Mariposa Grove Giant Sequoia Loop
activities.description: 6.6-mile loop through ancient giant sequoia forest with trails through groves of 1,500-year-old trees. Shuttle tram available or hike entire loop.

spots.name: El Capitan Meadow
spots.description: Classic granite monolith framed by meadow flowers and river in golden hour light with perfect symmetry.
spots.bestTime: Morning and evening light; spring for wildflowers

spots.name: Bridalveil Fall
spots.description: Ethereal waterfall with mist creating atmospheric light beams, especially dramatic during spring flow.
spots.bestTime: Late morning for backlit mist; May-July for maximum water

spots.name: Mirror Lake Reflection
spots.description: Perfect mirror-like reflections of Half Dome and surrounding peaks in calm water during early morning.
spots.bestTime: Early morning before wind; June-August for reliable water

spots.name: Glacier Point Overlook
spots.description: Panoramic vista encompassing Half Dome, Yosemite Valley, and distant Sierra peaks with dramatic lighting angles.
spots.bestTime: Sunset for warm tones; clear weather essential

spots.name: Valley View at El Capitan
spots.description: Wide-angle composition showcasing Bridalveil Fall, El Capitan, Cathedral Rocks, and flowing Merced River.
spots.bestTime: Golden hour for warm tones; winter for snow-capped peaks

spots.name: Vernal Fall Upper Trail
spots.description: Dynamic waterfall photography with misty spray, granite rocks, and varied perspectives along Mist Trail.
spots.bestTime: May-July for powerful water flow; late afternoon for side-light

spots.name: Tunnel View
spots.description: Iconic composition framing Bridalveil Fall, El Capitan, and Half Dome through natural granite rock frame.
spots.bestTime: Sunset for dramatic sky; any clear day

spots.name: Mariposa Grove Old Grove Section
spots.description: Ancient giant sequoias towering above with dramatic morning light filtering through canopy and fog.
spots.bestTime: Early morning fog for atmospheric light; fall for colored understory

spots.name: Half Dome from Sentinel Dome
spots.description: High-elevation perspective of Half Dome with dramatic shadows and distant mountain ranges visible.
spots.bestTime: Sunset for warm light on dome; clear weather for detail

spots.name: Tenaya Lake Alpine Landscape
spots.description: High-country alpine lake with Cathedral Range reflection and dramatic granite peak backgrounds.
spots.bestTime: Late afternoon light; August-September for clearest skies

lensRecommendations: 14-24mm ultra-wide for landscape vistas and waterfall compositions
50mm prime for intimate nature details and giant sequoia portraits
70-200mm telephoto for Half Dome compression and wildlife photography
16-35mm zoom for flexible landscape and architectural elements
photography.goldenHourNotes: Yosemite's granite cliffs turn brilliant orange and red during golden hour, particularly visible from Valley View and Glacier Point. Spring offers extended golden hours due to lower sun angles, while fall provides warm tones against changing foliage. Plan shots 30-60 minutes before sunset for optimal lighting on Half Dome and El Capitan.

weather.seasonality: Yosemite experiences four distinct seasons with summer (June-September) offering warm days, open roads, and accessible high country. Winter (December-February) brings snow, partially closed roads, and fewer crowds but creates stunning snowy landscape photography. Spring (March-May) features peak waterfall flows and wildflowers, while fall (September-November) offers crisp air, fewer visitors, and dramatic foliage.
weather.summary: The park's elevation (4,000-13,000 feet) creates significant temperature variations between valley floor and high country, with temperatures dropping 10°C for every 1,000 meters of elevation gained. Summer brings warm days (20-27°C) and dry conditions perfect for hiking, while winter often closes high elevation roads but provides serene landscapes for valley-based activities.

hotels.name: Yosemite Valley Lodge
hotels.description: Modern lodge with convenient valley location near restaurants, museums, and trailheads featuring comfortable rooms and mountain views.

hotels.name: Ahwahnee Hotel
hotels.description: Historic 1927 grand hotel with distinctive Art Deco architecture, fine dining, and iconic views of Half Dome and Yosemite Falls from its imposing granite structure.

hotels.name: Wawona Hotel
hotels.description: Historic Victorian-era hotel in charming Wawona village near Mariposa Grove with rustic charm and access to south park attractions.
